content:
设  
\[
P=3\ln(1+y)+5x^2,\qquad Q=\frac{3x}{1+y}-2y.
\]
因为
\[
\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=\frac{3}{1+y}=\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x},
\]
且曲线在 \(y>-1\) 区域内，所以该向量场为保守场。取势函数
\[
F(x,y)=3x\ln(1+y)+\frac{5}{3}x^3-y^2.
\]
则
\[
\int_C P\,dx+Q\,dy=F(B)-F(A).
\]

计算：
\[
F(B)=F(4,2)=12\ln3+\frac{320}{3}-4
=12\ln3+\frac{308}{3},
\]
\[
F(A)=F(1,1)=3\ln2+\frac{5}{3}-1
=3\ln2+\frac{2}{3}.
\]
所以
\[
F(B)-F(A)=12\ln3-3\ln2+102
=3\ln\frac{81}{2}+102.
\]

答案：C
